Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
Please be so kind as to direct on this letter.
I am taking the [Chaplet of Pearls](/book/69) to have a final reading by its greatest critics[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Perhaps [Mary Anne Dyson](/person/464) (who is known to have encouraged CMY to make Eustacie less adult) and her [sister-in-law](/person/462).
